elements.name: source-note
elements.text:
[1] A lossless compression and encryption mechanism for remote monitoring of ECG data
using Huffman coding and CBC-AES, FGCS 2019; simulated in MATLAB 2018a on Windows 7,
i5 2nd Gen, 8 GB RAM. N/R = not reported.
Note: ML precision is TP/(TP+FP); this slide uses byte-match correctness = matched bytes/total bytes.
RTL timing is measured from perf counters at 50 MHz on the five MIT-BIH records.
